synopsis: This is all that remains of Nabudis. Two years ago it was destroyed utterly by a mysterious force. / The work of the Midlight Shard. / This? In just 2 years? How? / As the Dawn Shard brought down the Leviathan and her fleet, a fell Mist spilled forth. / It is like the same thing happened here. / The nethicite's Mist has corrupted the life of this place. It is a necrohol overrun with beasts. / We tread here on a fool's errand. We had best turn back. / Is it revenge that you desire? / Yes or no, not this way lies the capital. / The road to Archades leads east of Salikawood, beyond the Phon Coast and Tchita Uplands. / Fran Archades does not lie this way. We travel east through the Salikawood, then follow the Phon Coast until we reach the Tchita Uplands. / Fran We travel east through the Salikawood, then follow the Phon Coast until we reach the Tchita Uplands.
flags_set: 0x0035: Opens the location map's exits between Necrohol of Nabudis and The Salikawood
plays_when: in Hall of Effulgent Light (Necrohol of Nabudis), when the party arrives while global byte 0x687 is 0 with the story counter below 3050 (Start of Head for Archades) or from 3210 (After Old Archades), or below 2 with the counter from 3050 and below 3210: the map's director reads and starts it (bds_a01 lines 318, 320, 321, 323 and 325; 346, 347, 349 and 351; 378, 379, 381 and 383) and then sets that byte to 1 below story counter 3050 and to 2 from it (lines 328, 360 and 385). The byte's only other stores outside the developer menus are in The Muted Scarp (Nabreus Deadlands), where walking into an area placed under the same tests plays another scene (bog_a0201) and sets the byte the same way (bog_a02 lines 1495, 1500 and 1505).

synopsis: Chaos appears in The Crucible and the Esper fight begins to Esper Battle (track 71).
plays_when: in The Crucible (Necrohol of Nabudis), when the party arrives while Chaos is undefeated (the battle byte, global byte 0xA1A, is 1 from the new game, pre_z0000 line 230, until the win): Chaos appears and the battle begins (bds_e01 lines 281 and 285 under the test at line 236). The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (line 180) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (lines 203 and 214).
